_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular register fragment — never edit shillinq_register.json
_meta.description: Additive overlay for filing through Digipoort (tax-digipoort-filing task 1.1). An XbrlInstance says what it files (`filingType`) and which VAT return it was built from (`sourceReturnId`); the entry point list gains the Belastingdienst OB (omzetbelasting) entry point, appended to the existing enum by the loader's list merge; a BtwAangifte points at the instance that files it (`xbrlInstanceId`); an XBRLTaxonomy record lists the entry points it carries (`entryPoints`), so the builders and the validation guard pick the taxonomy effective for a period and entry point. All new properties are optional, so existing rows keep validating. The taxonomy record also names, per release, the entry point schemas (`schemaRefs`), the concept namespaces (`namespaces`) and any concept it renames (`conceptMap`), which the XBRL builders write. Filing follows integriq: `submit` now stores the file and hands it to integriq (state handed-off, action hand-to-digipoort), `deliver` moves it to submitted only on integriq's delivery report carrying the Digipoort reference, and `retract` returns an undeliverable filing to validated; accept and reject stay inbound from submitted.

filingType.description: What this instance files: a VAT return to the Belastingdienst (`vat-return`, entry point belastingdienst-ob) or the annual accounts to the KvK (`kvk-deponering`, entry point kvk-jaarrekening). Set by the builder that made the instance.
filingType.title: Filing type

sourceReturnId.description: The BtwAangifte this VAT return instance was built from. Empty for an annual accounts instance, which names its statement in sourceStatementId.
sourceReturnId.title: Source return

payloadFileUri.description: The stored XBRL file handed to integriq's Digipoort connector, under /Shillinq/Sbr/<administrationId>/ in the files of whoever filed it.
payloadFileUri.title: Filed file

handOffReference.description: The correlation id the filing was handed to integriq with; integriq's status reports refer to the filing by it.
handOffReference.title: Hand-off reference

submit.label: Indienen
submit.description: Store the XBRL file and hand it to integriq's Digipoort connector (hand-to-digipoort). Refused when no filing connection is configured, so nothing is marked submitted that never left shillinq.

actions.description: Store the XML under /Shillinq/Sbr/<administrationId>/ and emit nl.conduction.sbr.filing.requested for integriq; set payloadFileUri and handOffReference.

deliver.label: Afgeleverd bij Digipoort
deliver.description: integriq reported the delivery; digipoortReceiptId and submittedAt are set. Refused without the Digipoort reference.

retract.label: Niet afgeleverd
retract.description: integriq could not deliver the filing; rejectionReason says why and the filing can be submitted again.

handed-off.label: Aangeboden
handed-off.description: Handed to integriq's Digipoort connector (source digipoort-sbr). Not yet submitted: it becomes submitted only when integriq reports the delivery with a Digipoort reference.

xbrlInstanceId.description: The XbrlInstance that files this return through Digipoort. The return mirrors that instance's state: submitted once the delivery is reported, accepted or rejected once the Belastingdienst's outcome is reported.
xbrlInstanceId.title: XBRL instance

entryPoints.description: The entry points this taxonomy version carries, such as belastingdienst-ob and kvk-jaarrekening. An instance is validated against the taxonomy effective for its period that lists its entry point.
entryPoints.title: Entry points

requiredConcepts.description: Per entry point, the concepts an instance must report before it may be validated, as prefix:name or bare name (any prefix), such as {"kvk-jaarrekening": ["jenv-bw2-i:Equity"]}. Read by the validation guard of XbrlInstance.
requiredConcepts.title: Required concepts

summations.description: Totals that must equal the sum of their parts in an instance of the named entry point, such as total assets as the sum of fixed and current assets. Read by the validation guard of XbrlInstance.
summations.title: Summations

schemaRefs.description: Per entry point, the URL of the entry point schema an instance refers to in its link:schemaRef, as the taxonomy release publishes it. Written into every instance the builders make for that entry point.
schemaRefs.title: Entry point schemas

namespaces.description: The namespace URI of each concept prefix the instances use, such as bd-i and jenv-bw2-i, as this taxonomy release defines them. A prefix this record does not name falls back to the builder's default.
namespaces.title: Concept namespaces

conceptMap.description: Per entry point, the concept a builder writes for each amount when this release names it differently from the builder's default, such as {"belastingdienst-ob": {"1a.vat": "bd-i:ValueAddedTaxSuppliesServicesGeneralTariff"}} or {"kvk-jaarrekening": {"equity": "jenv-bw2-i:Equity"}}. Keys are the VAT return box and amount (1a.base, 1a.vat, ..., 5g.vat) or the annual accounts line (fixedAssets, currentAssets, assets, equity, provisions, liabilities, netTurnover, operatingExpenses, financialResult, result).
conceptMap.title: Concept map
